subject: Pre-listing: asset rights, listing copy and support validation for marketplace
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <marketplace-team@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-listing: asset rights and support coverage for Redwood listing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Nimbus is preparing the vendor packet for our co-sell/transactable marketplace program and we have a short list of items we need from Redwood to proceed with the technical and legal review: 

- Confirmation of trademark/brand asset usage (do you have an approvals contact or a short brand usage statement we can include in the application?)
- Support coverage and escalation path for marketplace customers (SLA targets, support contact alias, hours-of-coverage)
- Proof of SOC2 or equivalent security posture (high level is fine at this stage)
- A one-paragraph listing blurb we can use verbatim on the marketplace page; legal will need to confirm claims text for product capabilities (e.g., "predictable latency", "dedicated GPU pools").

Could you send the items above or let me know if any of them need redlines? Nimbus requires the legal/ops packet by EOD Tuesday to keep our co-sell review on schedule.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Program Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
NimbusCloud Solutions

Attachment: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <marketplace-team@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-listing: asset rights and support coverage for Redwood listing

Samantha — thanks for the checklist and for driving the timeline. Looping in Marissa (marketplace/co-sell lead) and Karthik (product) so we can put together a single package. Quick answers and next steps below, we can follow up with legal redlines if Nimbus requires them.

1) Brand/trademark usage
- Attached: Redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf (approved logo variants, color-safe zones, small-type restrictions).
- We can provide a short approval statement for marketplace use: "Redwood Inference grants NimbusCloud a limited, non-exclusive right to use Redwood trademarks and approved brand assets for the purpose of listing and co-selling Redwood Inference on NimbusCloud's marketplace as described in the Marketplace Listing Application." If legal needs a different format, ask and we will run it through counsel.

2) Support & SLA
- For marketplace (hosted API) customers we offer standard support hours: M-F 07:00–19:00 PT with 24/7 pager escalation available for enterprise plans. Typical co-sell customers that require transactable listing select our "Enterprise" support add-on which includes 24/7 NOC coverage and a dedicated escalation alias.
- Baseline: 99.9% availability SLA for hosted tiers; we can discuss 99.95% for co-sell transactable profiles if Nimbus requires it — that typically involves a slightly different routing (dedicated pool / high-availability config) and a commitment from the partner on expected throughput.

3) Security posture
- Attached: SOC2-Readout.pdf (summary). We can provide the full report under NDA if Nimbus compliance needs deeper evidence.

4) Listing blurb
- Draft (one paragraph): "Redwood Inference is a high-performance inference platform that delivers predictable latency and cost-efficient LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Features include a model catalog, streaming responses, and enterprise-grade observability for production workloads." Please confirm if any product claims need softening for legal.

Next steps: Marissa, can you confirm whether Redwood is okay signing Nimbus' co-sell addendum and if we should expect a DocuSign? Karthik, please confirm whether product needs to pre-provision a dedicated pool for 99.95 SLA requests. Lauren, FYI for deal handoff if Nimbus proceeds.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps get everything over the line by Tuesday.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf; SOC2-Readout.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <marketplace-team@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-listing: asset rights and support coverage for Redwood listing

Thanks Priyom — this is great and helps a lot. A few clarifying points from Nimbus Ops & Legal: 

- SLA target: Nimbus requires 99.95% availability for transactable listings to qualify for the featured co-sell inventory. If Redwood can certify 99.95% (or commit to a plan to get there within a defined ramp window) we'll proceed. Please confirm whether that will require dedicated capacity or an HA configuration.
- Support alias: we need a single email alias (support+marketplace@redwood.ai or similar) and a 24/7 escalation contact for P1 incidents.
- Trademark clause: legal would like the one-line approval statement in a signed addendum; would you accept Nimbus' Marketplace IP Addendum (we can send DocuSign)?
- Claims language: legal flagged "predictable latency" — they prefer a safer phrasing such as "low-latency inference under typical production workloads" unless Redwood can provide a publicly available latency SLA. A small redline to the blurb would be fine.

Attached is our packaging checklist for vendor applicants: Nimbus_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx — it lists the minimum artifacts and the required evidence for each item.

If possible, can you get the signed IP Addendum and the support alias by EOD Tuesday? Legal is on a tight queue for the program start.

Thanks,
Samantha
Program Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
NimbusCloud Solutions

Attachments: Nimbus_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <marketplace-team@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-listing: asset rights and support coverage for Redwood listing

Samantha — thanks for the checklist and clarity. Quick internal update and commitments below (we're good to move forward):

- Trademark/brand: Redwood legal accepts Nimbus' IP Addendum. Priyom — I'll coordinate with legal to sign and return the DocuSign by EOD Tuesday.
- Support alias & escalation: created support+marketplace@redwood.ai; escalation contact is on-call@redwood.ai (rotates) and an actionable P1 pager goes to noc@redwood.ai. Ops confirms 24/7 escalation is in place for any transactable listings.
- SLA: Karthik confirms product can support a 99.95% availability target for the transactable listing, but it requires enabling dedicated pool provisioning and an HA routing policy. For the Nimbus listing we recommend the "Dedicated Premium" configuration; Karthik, please attach the provisioning estimate and expected lead time in Jira ticket: SUP-2247.
- Listing copy: attached listing_copy_v3.docx with a modest wording tweak per legal: "Redwood Inference provides low-latency inference for production LLM workloads with configurable deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private)." That softens the claim while keeping the core message.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/67890) and I'll approve the DocuSign once legal uploads. Priyom — please confirm you want me to submit the final package to Nimbus or if you prefer product to attach the provisioning estimate first.

Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: listing_copy_v3.docx
